1 · Intro

When to use it.

Payroll costing decides which account pays for a person's compensation, and for which periods. It matters for grant and contract research and for certain gifts.

Blank costing on an assignment is not an error. It means a default applies.

Use this whenYou need to decide whether an employee needs costing entered or can stay on the default.

2 · Walk through

How Oracle picks the account, then your decision.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Some departments set default costing at the work unit level, others at the business unit level. Know which applies to you.
  • Costing touches payroll and financial reporting. Wrong costing charges the wrong budget.
  • Costing practice varies by department. Validate with your finance partner.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Costing Management

Costing fundamentals

Use when: You need to decide whether an employee needs costing entered or can stay on the default. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Know the order Oracle checks.
    • Element (one payment, such as a bonus) costed? Use it.
    • Otherwise, assignment (the person's job) costed? Use it.
    • Otherwise, use the default for the assignment's work unit.
  2. Open the employee's assignment and check its costing.
  3. Blank? Salary charges to the work unit's default COA.
  4. Ask your finance partner whether your department splits the work unit by program code.
    • No split: leave the default. Nothing to enter.
    • Split: enter costing for each person. Otherwise they default to program 000.
  5. Ask whether finance wants any role tracked separately.

Watch-outs

  • Some departments set default costing at the work unit level, others at the business unit level. Know which applies to you.
  • Costing touches payroll and financial reporting. Wrong costing charges the wrong budget.
  • Costing practice varies by department. Validate with your finance partner.
